name: 48757-decodeheavy-32b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM, 64 layers, 64 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 5120) with fp8 linear weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 256 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 48757.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 128 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request with min == max == mean on both; prefix caching off.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 1024-token answers from brief prompts for 32 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine arguments for this setup.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8
model-impl: transformers
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
num-gpu-blocks-override: 32768
dtype: bfloat16
